steps.say: Thirty years I kept this gate. Every cart that went down to the Works, I counted. Every name, I wrote down. So that somebody would.
They told me it was mercy. The dying, given to the flame. I believed that for the first ten years.
After that I kept counting because I couldn't stop. If I stopped, they were only tallow.
Take the key. You'll want to see where the carts go. You won't want to have seen it.
Don't let them put me in the vats. Leave me here, where I can see the gate.
And tell Maudlin... tell her Anselm kept the count.
The candle behind his visor gutters, and goes out.
